title: Compact-density table row focus + chart live-region sweep for VPAT readiness
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Scope: This ticket covers an accessibility sweep focused on the new compact-density variant for tables and the updated chart component (legend/tooltips) to ensure VPAT readiness. The compact density update introduced tighter row hit targets and a custom drag-handle that broke logical tab order in several places. Charts have new interactive legends and tooltip transitions that are not currently announced to AT. Goals: 1) Make table rows and interactive controls keyboard operable with clear focus styling and predictable ARIA roles. 2) Ensure drag handles and row reordering are exposed to assistive tech (aria-grabbed/aria-dropeffect replacement pattern) and have a non-pointer fallback. 3) Add an aria-live strategy for chart updates and tooltips, and ensure legends can be navigated via keyboard with meaningful labels. 4) Produce VPAT coverage notes and remediation list for the audit team.

Acceptance criteria:
- Compact table rows pass 4.2.1 keyboard and 1.4.11 non-text contrast checks at compact density token values.
- Focus order for table rows and inline actions matches DOM reading order; no keyboard traps.
- Drag handles provide a keyboard interaction pattern (move up/down via Ctrl+Arrow or button alternative) with visible focus and ARIA annotations; a11y docs document the pattern.
- Charts announce dataset changes and tooltip content via polite aria-live without flooding screen readers; legend items are operable via keyboard and announce state (on/off) with aria-pressed or equivalent.
- All changes are documented in the VPAT checklist with test steps and sample AT narration.

Deliverables:
- Updated component token guidance (compact density contrast adjustments) in the design tokens confluence page.
- Design system PR(s) for Table and Chart with accessibility props and examples.
- Accessibility testing notes: ChromeVox, NVDA, VoiceOver, and Dragon (where applicable) with screen recordings attached.
- VPAT-ready addendum describing remediation and remaining gaps if any.

Trade-offs/Notes:
- We will avoid increasing visual density tokens beyond product intent; instead prefer micro-adjustments to focus rings and hit targets for keyboard users.
- Drag-and-drop reordering remains available to pointer users; keyboard-first fallback will follow ARIA Authoring Practices for reorderable list patterns rather than relying on deprecated aria-dropeffect.
- Some contrast fixes require token updates affecting other components; changes will be coordinated with tokens team and documented in the release notes.
comments: 2026-02-20 - Ava Martinez: Created initial scope and acceptance criteria. Linked to token audit and requested engineering time for keyboard handler changes.

2026-02-22 - Jonah Patel: Did a quick walkthrough of compact row DOM. Found three instances where inline action buttons were rendered off-DOM via portals causing tab skips. Flagged as blocker for In Progress.

2026-02-25 - Design Review: Agreed on using a visible 3px minimum focus ring in compact mode (token: focus-ring-compact) and increasing hit target padding around inline icons to 10px via invisible focus padding.

2026-02-28 - Accessibility Engineer (Maya Li): Implemented keyboard-reorder prototype using move actions (space to pick, arrow to move, space to drop) and shared a test harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/design-system/pull/4823

2026-03-03 - Jonah Patel: Engineering notes - portal usage fixed by moving inline controls into the row DOM for compact table; will follow up with perf regression tests. Patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/design-system/pull/4837

2026-03-06 - QA (Diego Ramos): Manual pass of keyboard navigation on staging; NVDA reported correct announcements for row selection but chart tooltip announcements were noisy. Suggested debounce on aria-live updates.

2026-03-09 - Maya Li: Implemented aria-live polite with 500ms debounce for tooltip content; added aria-hidden on transient decorative labels. Uploaded screen recordings: https://drive.redwood.ai/notes/a11y/compact-sweep/mar09

2026-03-12 - Jonah Patel: Preparing VPAT addendum draft. Remaining: confirm contrast token change with tokens team and finalize wording for keyboard-reorder pattern. Assigned follow-up DES-62701 to track token propagation.
2026-03-12 - Ava Martinez: Marking documentation tasks for Design System site. Will include example markup and VoiceOver expected narration lines.
